review_notes: I read the whole file and the Mathlib files it imports: ModuleCat/Stalk.lean and Presheaf/ColimitFunctor.lean. The forward and backward tensor-stalk comparison is not in Mathlib (my grep found no stalkTensor or stalk-tensor declarations), so I didn't flag it. The private abbreviations are notation, not competing concepts. The one real candidate is `stalkMapLinear`, which repeats Mathlib's `PresheafOfModules.ModuleColimit.map`. I did not check the defeq between the stalk type and `ModuleColimit hcR hcM`, which the proposed replacement relies on. The `stalkMapLinear` uses in ModuleTensorAffine.lean are not fully examined. The local `nativeStalkModule` instance is also redundant, but I judged it too minor to report.

findings.problem: The file builds its own `A.stalk x`-linear map on module stalks induced by a morphism `f : P ⟶ Q`. It does this with a new additive map `stalkMapAdd`, plus a hand-written `map_smul'` proof. The proof goes through `jointly_surjective₂` and `germ_smul`. Mathlib's ColimitFunctor.lean already has `PresheafOfModules.ModuleColimit.map`, a `cR.pt`-linear map between module colimits induced by a morphism of presheaves of modules. It is defined for exactly this colimit setup. Its `map_apply` lemma says it sends `ιM m` to `ιM (f.app _ m)`, which is the same germ formula as `stalkMapLinear_germ`. The target already works with `ModuleColimit` for the stalks (`PStalk` is defeq to the colimit point). `stalkMapLinear` therefore re-proves Mathlib's linearity argument in a second, competing form. It also adds a parallel API: `stalkMapAdd`, `stalkMapAdd_germ`, `stalkMapLinear_apply_stalkFunctor` and `stalkMapLinear_germ`.
findings.proposed_change: Define `stalkMapLinear` as `PresheafOfModules.ModuleColimit.map` applied to the pushforward morphism, with `hcA`, `hcP` and `hcQ` as the colimit data. The morphism would be the image of `f` under `pushforward₀ (OpenNhds.inclusion x) A`. Use `ModuleColimit.map_apply` to get `stalkMapLinear_germ`. Keep the public names `stalkMapLinear` and `stalkMapLinear_germ` as thin wrappers, so users in ModuleTensorAffine.lean are unaffected. `stalkMapLinear_apply_stalkFunctor` can be kept as a lemma if it is still needed. The `map_smul'` proof and `stalkMapAdd` can then go, or `stalkMapAdd` can stay as a private lemma-only helper.
findings.benefit: This removes a duplicated linearity proof and a competing definition of the induced stalk map. The stalk maps then share Mathlib's `map_id` and `comp_map` lemmas. Naturality and functoriality of the stalk tensor comparison can reuse them, where today they would have to be re-proved for `stalkMapLinear`.
